cnTitle: 太阳太阴同在命宫：又热又柔的人，怎么把两股劲用顺
enTitle: Sun and Moon Together in the Life Palace: Balancing Warmth and Softness in One Nature
enDesc: The Sun is warm and outward while the Moon is sensitive and inward. People with both in the Life Palace shift between bold and gentle, generous and careful, which makes them rich in nature yet prone to inner conflict. The key is not removing the contrast but letting each side lead at the right moment.
cnDesc: 太阳主热情外放、太阴主细腻内敛，两颗主星同在命宫的人，对人冷热、对钱松紧会随状态切换，显得丰富也容易纠结。关键不是消灭矛盾，而是让该出手时的太阳和该收束时的太阴各归各位。

cnTitle: 太阳太阴同在福德宫：精神世界又亮又细，怎么让心安定
enTitle: Sun and Moon Together in the Karma Palace: A Mind That Is Both Bright and Refined
enDesc: The Karma Palace governs inner feeling and how one finds satisfaction. With the Sun and Moon there, the inner world is rich and layered, able to enjoy both contribution and solitude, though the two can pull between restlessness and overthinking.
cnDesc: 福德宫管一个人内在的感受与满足方式，太阳太阴同落在这里，精神世界丰富、兴趣和情绪层次多，既能从奉献里得乐、也能从独处中得安；但两星拉扯时容易一会儿闲不住、一会儿想太多。

cnTitle: 天机太阴同在迁移宫：在外善规划又细腻，怎么把路走宽
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tai Yin Together in the Migration Palace: A Thoughtful, Refined Way Out in the World
enDesc: The Migration Palace governs one’s stage and opportunities in the outer world. Tian Ji plans and adapts while Tai Yin is sensitive and refined; together they build a place through thought and care, suiting external work that calls for strategy, taste and communication, while guarding against overthinking and oversensitivity.
cnDesc: 迁移宫管一个人在外部世界的舞台与机缘，天机善规划应变、太阴细腻懂感受，两星同落在这里，在外靠脑子和细致立足，适合需要策划、审美与沟通的外部发展；但要防想太多而迈不开、或在外过于敏感。

cnTitle: 紫微天府同在疾厄宫：底子厚但要防「硬扛」，身体喜欢有节奏
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tian Fu in the Health Palace: A Strong Constitution That Must Not Be Run on Pride Alone
enDesc: The Health Palace governs constitution and how the body bears pressure. Zi Wei carries dignity and Tian Fu solidity, so the baseline is usually strong with decent recovery; yet both tend toward pride and endurance, so the main risk is not sudden illness but the slow backlog of pushing too hard with irregular rest.
cnDesc: 疾厄宫管体质与身体的承压方式，紫微主尊贵、天府主厚实，两星同落在这里，先天底子通常不弱、恢复力尚可；但两星都偏「要强、能扛」，最容易出现的不是大病，而是长期硬撑、作息不规律带来的积压。

cnTitle: 武曲天相同在兄弟宫：平辈务实讲分寸，怎么处好这层关系
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Xiang in the Siblings Palace: Practical, Principled Peers and How to Keep the Bond Steady
enDesc: The Siblings Palace covers siblings and peers, along with peer-level cooperation and money matters. Wu Qu is practical and rule-oriented while Tian Xiang is upright and tactful, so the people around you tend to be steady and principled and the bond rational and stable, though neither is sentimental, so one must guard against principles crowding out warmth.
cnDesc: 兄弟宫看手足与同辈、也看平辈间的合作与资金往来，武曲务实讲规则、天相正派懂分寸，两星同落在这里，身边多是踏实、讲规矩的同辈，关系偏理性稳定；但两星都不擅甜腻表达，要防有事只讲原则、少了情分。

cnTitle: 天同天梁同在父母宫：长辈温和有荫庇，怎么承接这份照顾
enTitle: Tian Tong and Tian Liang in the Parents Palace: Warm, Sheltering Elders and How to Receive the Care
enDesc: The Parents Palace covers elders, upbringing and shelter. Tian Tong is warm and childlike while Tian Liang is steady and protective, so elders tend to be soft-hearted and nurturing, with a warm home willing to catch you; yet too much shelter can pull between independence and dependence.
cnDesc: 父母宫看长辈缘、家教与庇荫，天同温和孩子气、天梁稳重能荫庇，两星同落在这里，长辈多是心软、照顾型，家庭氛围偏暖、愿意兜底；但照顾太足时，容易在独立和依赖之间拉扯。

cnTitle: 紫微斗数和七政四余有什么不同：两套中式命理看的不是一回事
enTitle: Zi Wei Dou Shu vs Qi Zheng Si Yu: Two Chinese Systems Reading Different Things
enDesc: Qi Zheng Si Yu, also tied to the Guo Lao star tradition, reads the sun, moon and visible planets against the zodiac and lunar lodges, leaning toward cosmic correspondence and the shape of a whole life; Zi Wei Dou Shu places symbolic stars in twelve human-affairs palaces with the four transformations, leaning toward concrete affairs and timing. Both use birth time but differ in coordinates, stars and focus.
cnDesc: 七政四余（果老星宗）以日月五星等真实天体按黄道二十八宿推命，偏天人相应与一生格局；紫微斗数以一套星曜落入十二人事宫、配四化推命，偏具体人事与时机。两者都用出生时间，但坐标、星曜和侧重不同。

cnTitle: 看财运为什么要三个宫一起看：现金流、资产和收入来源别混
enTitle: Why Wealth Needs Three Palaces: Cash Flow, Assets and Income Source Are Not the Same
enDesc: The Wealth Palace reads cash flow and spending habits, the Property Palace fixed assets and accumulated wealth, and the Career Palace the income your work provides; together they form the full financial structure. One palace alone misreads cases such as earning well yet saving little or holding a high title with tight cash.
cnDesc: 财帛宫看现金流与花钱习惯，田宅宫看固定资产与资产沉淀，官禄宫看职业带来的收入来源，三者合起来才是完整的财富结构。只看一个宫，常会误判「赚得多却留不住」或「职位高但现金紧」。

cnTitle: 2026丙午年文昌化科落十二宫：文书、考试与名声在哪一宫变顺
enTitle: 2026 Wen Chang Hua Ke Across the Twelve Palaces: Where Documents, Exams and Reputation Smooth Out
enDesc: Wen Chang governs documents, learning, talent and order, while Hua Ke governs being seen, recognized and smoothed. In the 2026 Bing Wu year, whichever palace receives Wen Chang Hua Ke tends to bring recognition, smoother exams and paperwork and a better reputation there, though it works slowly and still needs action and Lu or Quan to land.
cnDesc: 文昌主文书、学业、才华与条理，化科主被看见、被认可与缓和。2026 丙午年文昌化科，落在哪一宫，就在那件事上容易得名、考试文书偏顺、口碑变好；但科主名偏缓，仍要配行动与禄权才落地。

cnTitle: 大限走紫微这十年：想站到主位上，怎么把位置坐稳
enTitle: The Zi Wei Decade: Stepping Into a Leading Role and Learning to Hold the Seat
enDesc: When Zi Wei hosts the decade Life Palace, the ten-year theme leans to leadership, responsibility, status and control, and one is often pushed to initiate, answer for and be visible. The opportunity is in carrying responsibility; the risk is proud isolation and doing it alone, so the key is learning to use a supporting team.
cnDesc: 十年大限的命宫由紫微主事，这十年人生主题偏「主位、责任、身份与掌控」，容易被推到牵头、负责、被看见的位置。机会在能不能担事，风险在孤高硬撑、缺辅佐，关键是学会用班底而不是单打独斗。

cnTitle: 大限走贪狼这十年：机会和欲望一起变多，怎么收放
enTitle: The Tan Lang Decade: When Opportunities and Appetites Both Multiply
enDesc: Tan Lang governs appetite, versatility, social life and change. In its decade, networks, opportunities, interests and romance all grow more active, suiting expansion, learning and crossing fields. The strength is liveliness; the risk is overreaching, entertaining-related drain and distraction, so the key is gathering desires into a few main lines.
cnDesc: 贪狼主欲望、多才、交际与变化，大限走贪狼的十年，人脉、机会、兴趣和桃花都会比以前活跃，适合拓展、学习与跨界。好处是路子活，风险是贪多嚼不烂、应酬损耗与分心，关键是把欲望收成几条主线。

cnTitle: 大限走太阳这十年：想发光、想帮人，怎么照亮别人也不亏自己
enTitle: The Tai Yang Decade: Wanting to Shine and Help Without Burning Yourself Out
enDesc: Tai Yang governs warmth, dedication, visibility and responsibility. In its decade, ambition, social involvement and the sense of being needed grow stronger, suiting a more public role. The strength is light and heat; the risk is overwork and tending the outside while neglecting the inside, so the key is directing and bounding that giving.
cnDesc: 太阳主热情、奉献、曝光与责任，大限走太阳的十年，事业心、社会参与和「被需要」的感受明显增强，适合站到台前、承担公共角色。好处是有光有热，风险是操劳过度、顾外不顾内，关键是给付出设方向和边界。

cnTitle: 大限走天机这十年：脑子转得快、变动也多，怎么把想法落地
enTitle: The Tian Ji Decade: A Quick Mind and Many Changes, and How to Land the Ideas
enDesc: Tian Ji governs thought, planning, learning and adaptiveness. In its decade, ideas, opportunities and changes come denser than before, suiting study, planning, transitions and intellectual work. The strength is quick reactions and many ideas; the risk is overthinking, frequent shifts and weak focus, so the key is gathering thought into executable steps.
cnDesc: 天机主思维、策划、学习与机变，大限走天机的十年，想法、机会和变动都比以前密，适合学习、规划、转型与动脑的事。好处是反应快、点子多，风险是想太多、频繁变动、难专注，关键是把思考收成可执行的步骤。

cnTitle: 大限走七杀这十年：要攻坚、要独立，怎么把硬骨头啃下来
enTitle: The Qi Sha Decade: Taking On Hard Problems Independently and Seeing Them Through
enDesc: Qi Sha governs courage, execution, independence and tackling hard problems. In its decade, the rhythm leans to tough battles, opening new ground and relying on oneself, often bringing situations that demand resolve and accountability. The strength is daring and dependability; the risk is solitude, risk-taking and physical cost, so the key is choosing the right battles and keeping a fallback.
cnDesc: 七杀主果敢、执行、独立与攻坚，大限走七杀的十年，人生节奏偏「硬仗、开拓、靠自己」，容易遇到需要决断和承担的局面。好处是有魄力、能扛事，风险是孤克、冒险与健康损耗，关键是选对战场、留好后路。

cnTitle: 大限走武曲这十年：务实、讲执行，怎么把事做成、把钱攒稳
enTitle: The Wu Qu Decade: Pragmatism and Execution, Getting Things Done and Building Steady Savings
enDesc: Wu Qu governs reason, pragmatism, execution and finance. In its decade the theme leans to real work, responsibility and financial accumulation, suiting those who build a place through expertise and follow-through. The strength is being results-oriented and capable; the risk is rigid solitude, overwork and money-related friction, so the key is directing that hardness to long-term building and learning softness.
cnDesc: 武曲主理性、务实、执行与财务，大限走武曲的十年，人生主题偏「实干、责任、财务积累」，适合靠专业和执行力立身。好处是结果导向、能成事，风险是孤刚、过劳与谈钱伤情，关键是把硬劲用在长期积累上、也学会柔软。

cnTitle: 大限走破军这十年：先破后立，怎么把旧局面换成新天地
enTitle: The Po Jun Decade: Breaking First to Build After, Replacing the Old with New Ground
enDesc: Po Jun governs transformation, restart and success after expenditure. In its decade, life often brings restructuring, moves, transitions and reshuffled relationships, as the old must go for the new to come. The strength is the courage to begin again; the risk is major breaks, upheaval and loss, so the key is being clear on what to break, what to build and what serves as a safety net.
cnDesc: 破军主变革、重启、耗而后成，大限走破军的十年，人生容易经历重组、搬迁、转型与关系的重新洗牌，旧的不去新的不来。好处是有推倒重来的魄力，风险是大破、动荡与损耗，关键是想清楚破什么、立什么、拿什么兜底。

cnTitle: 紫微天府同在官禄宫：事业上既有主位也有库藏，怎么把局面做大做稳
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tian Fu in the Career Palace: Leading and Holding Resources in One Career
enDesc: The Career Palace reads how one works and the shape of a career. Zi Wei leads and coordinates while Tian Fu steadies and conserves, so together one can both initiate and hold resources, suiting management, coordination and large platforms. The risk is conservatism, weak originality and proud isolation, so the key is making room for innovation and delegation alongside stewardship.
cnDesc: 官禄宫看做事方式与事业格局，紫微主统筹主导、天府主厚实守成，两星同落在这里，事业上既能牵头、又能稳住资源，适合管理、统筹与大型平台。风险在偏保守、缺独创、孤高，关键是在守成之外留出创新与授权。

cnTitle: 天机太阴同在官禄宫：事业靠脑子也靠细致，怎么把规划做成成果
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tai Yin in the Career Palace: A Career Built on Thought and Refinement
enDesc: Tian Ji plans and adapts while Tai Yin is refined and tasteful. Together in the Career Palace they suit strategy, design, office work, consulting and research, building a place through expertise and care. The strength is thoroughness and taste; the risk is overthinking, frequent change and slow decisions, so the key is turning plans into rhythm and results.
cnDesc: 天机善策划应变、太阴细腻懂审美，两星同在官禄，事业上适合规划、设计、文职、咨询与研究类工作，靠专业与细致立身。好处是周全有美感，风险是想太多、变动多、决断慢，关键是把策划落到节奏与成果。

cnTitle: 武曲七杀同在官禄宫：事业敢打硬仗，怎么把冲劲用成事业
enTitle: Wu Qu and Qi Sha in the Career Palace: Daring Hard Battles and Turning Drive Into a Career
enDesc: Wu Qu is pragmatic and execution-oriented while Qi Sha is courageous and tackles hard problems. Together in the Career Palace they bring strong drive, resolve and the ability to carry difficult work, suiting high-pressure sales, engineering, law, enforcement or entrepreneurship. The risk is head-on clashes, risk and solitude, so the key is courage with a plan, the right direction and a fallback.
cnDesc: 武曲务实讲执行、七杀果敢能攻坚，两星同在官禄，事业上冲劲足、敢决断、能啃硬骨头，适合业务攻坚、工程、政法或自主创业。风险是硬碰、冒险、孤克，关键是勇而有谋、选对方向并留后路。

cnTitle: 天同巨门同在官禄宫：事业靠服务与表达，怎么把话说对、把事做稳
enTitle: Tian Tong and Ju Men in the Career Palace: A Career Built on Service and Expression
enDesc: Tian Tong is warm and service-oriented while Ju Men is analytical and expressive. Together in the Career Palace they suit teaching, communication, customer service, consulting and roles built on dialogue, with both approachability and logic. The risk is disputes and emotional ups and downs, so the key is grounding expression in expertise and holding tact.
cnDesc: 天同温和主服务、巨门善辨析主表达，两星同在官禄，事业上适合教学、传播、客服、咨询与靠沟通立身的岗位，亲和力与逻辑都不弱。风险是口舌是非、情绪起伏，关键是把表达接到专业上、把分寸立住。

cnTitle: 廉贞七杀同在官禄宫：事业刚猛能开创，怎么把魄力用得稳
enTitle: Lian Zhen and Qi Sha in the Career Palace: Fierce Pioneering Energy and How to Use It Steadily
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs principles and daring while Qi Sha governs courage and hard tasks. Together in the Career Palace they bring strong drive and pioneering ability, suiting reform, high-difficulty work, law and enforcement and demanding roles. The risk is fierce energy that snaps, risk-taking and friction, so the key is pairing daring with rules, risk judgment and a team.
cnDesc: 廉贞主原则与魄力、七杀主果敢与攻坚，两星同在官禄，事业上行动力和开创力都强，适合改革、攻坚、政法与高挑战岗位。风险是刚猛易折、冒险与刑克，关键是给魄力配上规则、风险判断和团队。

cnTitle: 紫微天府同在田宅宫：家庭重体面也重积累，怎么把家经营稳
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tian Fu in the Property Palace: A Home That Values Both Dignity and Accumulation
enDesc: The Property Palace reads home, real estate and accumulated assets. Zi Wei carries dignity and leadership while Tian Fu carries solidity and storage, so family matters, relatively steady assets and orderly home life, with a willingness to build for the household. The risk is face concerns, strong hierarchy at home and conservatism, so the key is letting the home hold both dignity and ease.
cnDesc: 田宅宫看家庭、房产与资产沉淀，紫微主体面主导、天府主厚实守藏，两星同落在这里，家庭观念重、家产相对稳、讲究居家秩序，顾家也愿意为家积累。风险是好面子、家里层级感强、偏保守，关键是让家既有体面也有松弛。

cnTitle: 天机天梁同在夫妻宫：伴侣善思又成熟，怎么把关心不变成说教
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tian Liang in the Spouse Palace: A Thoughtful, Mature Partner and Keeping Care From Turning Into Lectures
enDesc: The Spouse Palace reads the long-term relationship pattern. Tian Ji is thoughtful and adaptive while Tian Liang is mature and protective, so partners tend to be bright, opinionated and caring, with plenty of communication and advice. The risk is excessive rationality, worry and lecturing, so the key is turning suggestions into companionship and respect.
cnDesc: 夫妻宫看长期关系的互动模式，天机善思善变、天梁成熟能荫庇，两星同落在这里，伴侣多是聪明、有主见、肯照顾人的类型，关系里沟通和忠告不少。风险是理性过头、爱操心好说教，关键是把建议收成陪伴和尊重。

cnTitle: 廉贞天相同在夫妻宫：伴侣有原则也懂分寸，怎么处好外柔内刚的关系
enTitle: Lian Zhen and Tian Xiang in the Spouse Palace: A Principled, Tactful Partner in a Bond That Is Soft Outside and Firm Within
enDesc: Lian Zhen governs principles and feeling while Tian Xiang governs integrity and tact. Together in the Spouse Palace, partners tend to be proper, dignified and soft outside yet firm within, valuing both responsibility and tact. The risk is sensitivity, excessive rules and tangling over issues, so the key is using principles for boundaries and keeping softness for daily life.
cnDesc: 廉贞主原则与感受、天相主正派与分寸，两星同在夫妻，伴侣多是有规矩、懂体面、外柔内刚的类型，关系讲责任也讲分寸。风险是敏感、规则感过强、遇事纠缠，关键是把原则用在边界上、把柔软留给日常。

cnTitle: 紫微天府同在财帛宫：赚钱有主位、留钱有库藏，怎么把财管稳
enTitle: Zi Wei and Tian Fu in the Wealth Palace: Earning from a Leading Place and Keeping It in the Treasury
enDesc: The Wealth Palace reads cash flow and how one manages money. Zi Wei leads and coordinates while Tian Fu stores and steadies, so together one earns with breadth and manages with order, suiting fund management, large operations and steady finance. The risk is conservatism, face-related spending and proud isolation, so the key is letting money move and grow alongside keeping it, and sharing appropriately.
cnDesc: 财帛宫看现金流与理财方式，紫微主主导统筹、天府主守藏厚实，两星同落在这里，赚钱有格局、管钱有章法，适合管理资金、经营大盘与稳健理财。风险是保守、面子消费与孤高，关键是在守财之外让钱流动、生息并适度分享。

cnTitle: 天机太阴同在财帛宫：赚钱靠策划和细致，怎么把脑力变成稳定收入
enTitle: Tian Ji and Tai Yin in the Wealth Palace: Earning Through Planning and Care, Turning Thought Into Steady Income
enDesc: Tian Ji plans and adapts while Tai Yin is refined and careful with money. Together in the Wealth Palace they earn through thought, expertise and care, suiting strategy, design, office work, consulting and indirect or skill-based income. The risk is shifting ideas, money passing through and slow decisions, so the key is gathering thought into a steady income structure and savings habit.
cnDesc: 天机善策划应变、太阴细腻懂守财，两星同在财帛，赚钱靠脑子、专业与细致，适合策划、设计、文职、咨询及间接财、技术财。风险是想法多变、过手财、决断慢，关键是把脑力收成稳定的收入结构和留存习惯。

cnTitle: 武曲天相同在财帛宫：赚钱务实讲规矩，怎么把正派经营做成财
enTitle: Wu Qu and Tian Xiang in the Wealth Palace: Practical, Principled Earning and Turning Upright Business Into Wealth
enDesc: Wu Qu is pragmatic and execution-oriented while Tian Xiang is upright and good at coordination. Together in the Wealth Palace they earn through rules, expertise and reputation, suiting finance, management, agency, fiscal work and institutional business. The risk is rigid rules, financial pressure and burdens through guarantees or titles, so the key is keeping rules clear and boundaries held.
cnDesc: 武曲务实讲执行、天相正派懂协调，两星同在财帛，赚钱靠规则、专业与信誉，适合金融、管理、代理、财政与制度化经营。风险是规则刚硬、财务压力与因印绶（担保、名分）生累，关键是把规矩立清、把边界守住。

cnTitle: 天同太阴同在财帛宫：赚钱温和求稳，怎么把日子过成细水长流
enTitle: Tian Tong and Tai Yin in the Wealth Palace: Gentle, Steady Earning and a Long, Even Flow
enDesc: Tian Tong is warm and easygoing while Tai Yin is refined and careful with money. Together in the Wealth Palace they do not favor aggressive earning, suiting services, education, markets oriented toward women, steady salaries and indirect income, with even cash flow and a willingness to save. The risk is complacency, passivity and slow growth, so the key is setting growth goals on top of stability.
cnDesc: 天同温和主福气、太阴细腻主守财，两星同在财帛，赚钱不偏好猛冲，适合服务、文教、女性向市场与稳定薪水、间接财，现金流偏平稳、也愿意储蓄。风险是安于现状、偏被动、进账慢，关键是在稳的基础上设增长目标。

cnTitle: 天同天梁同在财帛宫：赚钱随缘重服务，怎么把清高变成稳定的财源
enTitle: Tian Tong and Tian Liang in the Wealth Palace: Earning Through Service Rather Than Strain
enDesc: Tian Tong is harmonious while Tian Liang is protective and principled. Together in the Wealth Palace earning leans to ease, reputation and service, suiting education, public-good work, consulting, stable institutions and caring fields, with income that arrives gently but stays relatively clean and supported. The risk is passive detachment from money, so the key is actively managing income alongside letting things come.
cnDesc: 天同和气、天梁荫庇讲原则，两星同在财帛，赚钱偏随缘、重口碑与服务，适合文教、公益、咨询、稳定体制与照顾型行业，财来得不猛但相对干净、有人帮。风险是被动清高、不积极争取，关键是在随缘之外主动经营收入。

cnTitle: 武曲破军同在子女宫：孩子务实又有变革劲，怎么给空间又立规矩
enTitle: Wu Qu and Po Jun in the Children Palace: A Practical, Transformative Child and Balancing Space with Rules
enDesc: The Children Palace reads the bond with children and the parenting pattern. Wu Qu is practical and rule-oriented while Po Jun dares to change and restart, so children tend to be independent, able to bear hardship, opinionated and eager to break old patterns, with strong drive. The risk is head-on clashes, frequent change, time apart or large spending on the child, so the key is giving room while holding rules and presence.
cnDesc: 子女宫看子女缘分与亲子模式，武曲务实讲规则、破军敢变敢重启，两星同落在这里，孩子多是独立、能吃苦、有主见、爱破旧局的类型，行动力强。风险是硬碰、变动多、聚少离多或为孩子花费大，关键是给足空间、也把规矩和陪伴立住。

cnTitle: 蜚廉在命宫：心思细、感受敏，怎么把「怕流言」活成观察力
enTitle: Fei Lian in the Life Palace: A Refined, Sensitive Nature That Turns Fear of Rumor Into Insight
enDesc: Fei Lian governs rumors, solitude and refinement. In the Life Palace one is sensitive, observant and conscientious, yet easily takes outside chatter to heart and can seem reserved. It does not bring major misfortune; the key is turning sensitivity into thoroughness, research and investigative skill, and building steady self-regard.
cnDesc: 蜚廉主口舌流言、孤僻与细腻，落命宫的人感受敏锐、观察力强、做事认真，也容易把外界的闲言放在心上、显得不太合群。它不主大凶，关键是把敏感转化为细致、研究与调查的能力，并主动建立稳固的自我评价。

cnTitle: 蜚廉在官禄宫：职场上防小是非，怎么把谨慎变成专业严谨
enTitle: Fei Lian in the Career Palace: Guarding Against Small Workplace Gossip and Turning Care Into Professional Rigor
enDesc: Fei Lian in the Career Palace can bring small workplace disputes, quiet gossip or minor process friction, while also indicating careful, rule-based work and an ability to spot problems. It does not mean career failure; the key is using care for process and quality, keeping communication documented, not passing rumors and building a professional reputation.
cnDesc: 蜚廉落官禄宫，职场上容易遇到说不清的小是非、暗中的闲话或流程上的小别扭，也主做事细、讲规矩、能查问题。它不主事业破败，关键是把谨慎用在流程和质量上，沟通留痕、不传话，把专业口碑做起来。

cnTitle: 蜚廉在疾厄宫：体质偏敏感，怎么把卫生和小感染管在前面
enTitle: Fei Lian in the Health Palace: A Sensitive Constitution and Staying Ahead of Hygiene and Minor Infections
enDesc: Fei Lian in the Health Palace tends to relate to germs, minor infections, allergies and a sensitive constitution, along with a body that reacts finely to changes in environment. It does not indicate serious illness; the key is good hygiene, attention to food and living conditions and seeking a licensed provider when symptoms persist, rather than worrying over the star name.
cnDesc: 蜚廉落疾厄宫，象意多与细菌、病毒、小感染、过敏及体质敏感有关，也主身体对环境变化反应细。它不主大病大灾，关键是讲卫生、留意饮食与居住环境，出现持续不适及时到正规机构检查，而不是对着星名瞎担心。

cnTitle: 大耗在命宫：为人慷慨看得开，怎么把「爱花」管成有度
enTitle: Da Hao in the Life Palace: Generous and Open-Handed, and How to Keep Spending in Measure
enDesc: People with Da Hao in the Life Palace tend to be generous and relaxed about money, willing to treat and share, while being prone to waste, big ups and downs and weak persistence. It does not mean lifelong loss; the key is pairing generosity with a budget and goals, using planned, intentional expenditure instead of passive, impulsive loss.
cnDesc: 大耗落命宫的人，多半性情大方、对钱看得开、愿意请客分享，也容易浪费、做事大起大落、缺恒心。它不等于一生破财，关键是给慷慨配上预算和目标，用「主动、有计划的耗」代替被动、冲动的失。

cnTitle: 大耗在财帛宫：现金流容易大进大出，怎么把口子收住
enTitle: Da Hao in the Wealth Palace: When Cash Flow Swings Wide and How to Hold the Opening
enDesc: Da Hao in the Wealth Palace makes the relationship with money loose, prone to large inflows and outflows, low sensitivity to cost and thin reserves, with sizable spending possible in investment, business or social obligations. It does not mean no money; the key is disciplining cash flow with a budget, savings and risk control.
cnDesc: 大耗落财帛宫，跟钱的关系偏松：容易大手笔进出、对成本不敏感、积蓄偏少，也可能在投资、生意、人情上出现较大支出。它不等于没钱，关键是给现金流立纪律——预算、留存、风控一个不少。

cnTitle: 大耗在田宅宫：守好家产这道库，怎么防不动产的损耗
enTitle: Da Hao in the Property Palace: Guarding the Household Treasury Against Loss to Fixed Assets
enDesc: The Property Palace is the household treasury, and Da Hao there most risks major loss to fixed assets: buying high before a drop, overspending on renovation, theft, fire scares or large home expenses. It does not mean the home must fail; the key is security, insurance and rational decisions, guarding the treasury well.
cnDesc: 田宅宫是家产之库，大耗落在这里，最怕不动产上的大损耗：高价置业后贬值、装修超支、被盗、火灾虚惊或家中大额开销。它不代表一定败宅，关键是重安防、留保险、理性决策，把「库」看牢。

cnTitle: 天空在命宫：想法超脱、精神自由，怎么不把聪明活成空想
enTitle: Tian Kong in the Life Palace: An Unconventional, Free Mind and How Not to Let Cleverness Drift Into Fantasy
enDesc: Tian Kong governs original, detached thought and a dislike of constraint. In the Life Palace one has strong imagination, a wide inner world and relative indifference to fame and gain, suiting creativity, design, research, philosophy and spiritual fields. The risk is fantasy, impracticality and disconnect from reality, so the key is giving detached ideas a handle to land.
cnDesc: 天空主思想独特、超脱、不爱拘束，落命宫的人想象力强、精神世界开阔、对名利相对淡，适合创意、设计、研究、哲学与精神领域。风险是空想、不切实际、与现实脱节，关键是给超脱的想法一个落地的抓手。

cnTitle: 天空在财帛宫：钱不宜只攥在手里，靠知识与创意反而更顺
enTitle: Tian Kong in the Wealth Palace: Money That Does Better Through Knowledge and Creativity Than Being Gripped Tight
enDesc: Tian Kong in the Wealth Palace loosens the grip on tangible money, and things that rely only on hoarding or speculation tend to fall through; monetizing knowledge, creativity, design, content, skill and spiritual services works better. The key is recognizing an intangible earning style and disciplining cash flow.
cnDesc: 天空落财帛宫，对实物钱财的掌控感偏松，硬做只靠囤货、炒卖的事容易落空；但靠知识、创意、设计、内容、技术与精神服务变现反而顺。关键是认清自己的财路偏「无形」，并给现金流立纪律。

cnTitle: 天福在命宫：温和敦厚带天赐之福，怎么顺势把福分养厚
enTitle: Tian Fu Xing in the Life Palace: A Warm, Steady Nature With an Innate Blessing
enDesc: Tian Fu Xing governs salary-blessings, longevity and innate good fortune. In the Life Palace one is warm, sincere, steady and hardworking, often finding that difficulties turn around and helpful people appear, growing steadier after midlife. It is not passive waiting; the key is nurturing relationships, health and expertise in line with the nature.
cnDesc: 天福主爵禄、福寿与天赐之福，落命宫的人性情温和敦厚、待人诚恳、做事稳重、任劳任怨，一生多逢凶化吉、贵人相助，中年后更稳。它不是坐等天降，关键是顺着本性把人和、健康与专业慢慢养厚。

cnTitle: 天福在官禄宫：事业稳、有福报，怎么把岗位做成长久的安稳
enTitle: Tian Fu Xing in the Career Palace: A Steady, Blessed Career Built Into Lasting Security
enDesc: Tian Fu Xing in the Career Palace adds steadiness and good fortune to work: one is reliable and treated well with support, suiting stable professional roles, education, welfare-oriented and institutional fields, with firmer position and rewards after midlife. The key is continuing to improve within security and deepening reputation.
cnDesc: 天福落官禄宫，事业上多一分稳、一分福报：做事稳重可靠、能得善待与提携，适合稳定的专业岗位、文教、福利型与制度化行业，中年后职分和待遇往往更踏实。关键是在安稳里持续精进、把口碑做厚。
